goal: Implement Slice S2 of Initiative explicit-phase-entry per docs/specs/explicit-phase-entry.spec.md (T1, T2): a host-neutral phase-entry module plus the Claude Code gate, so enroll and start_unattended_batch are refused before any native dialog in a session without a live literal-user imm-run entry, and a model Skill call for imm-planner, imm-brainstorm or imm-run is denied without a matching entry. Characterize the real UserPromptSubmit payload of a slash entry first (assumption A1). User scenarios SCN-3 and SCN-4 belong to this Slice.

acceptance.assertion: Per T1 and invariants I2, I3 of docs/specs/explicit-phase-entry.spec.md (source: delegated technical choices D3, D7): runtime/assurance/phase_entry.ts recognizes a literal entry for imm-planner, imm-brainstorm and imm-run by packaged name, by immune-brain: or skill: prefix, by a user alias whose command file names exactly one of those skills (imm-loop maps to run), and in the Host-expanded command form; a mid-sentence mention, an unknown command and non-user text are not entries. A run entry stays live across later prompts; a later plan entry revokes it; a missing or unreadable store refuses. Seam: new tests/phase-entry.test.ts on the pure module with positive, negative and bound controls for each rule.

Per T2 and invariants I1, I3, I5 of docs/specs/explicit-phase-entry.spec.md (source: user decision U2; repository evidence runtime/claude/mcp_server.ts): on Claude Code, enroll and start_unattended_batch reach the native gate port only when the session has a live run entry and the PreToolUse hook wrote an admission for the call's claudecode/toolUseId; with no entry, a revoked entry, or no admission the call returns reason code run_entry_required with exactly one same-Host recovery action and the gate port is never called; batch-internal reuseOnly continuation is not gated. Seam: new tests/claude-phase-entry-gate.test.ts driving the hook output functions and handleJsonRpc.

Per T1, T2 and decision D4 of docs/specs/explicit-phase-entry.spec.md (source: user decision U2 refined by D4): the Claude PreToolUse hook denies a Skill call for imm-planner, imm-brainstorm or imm-run with reason code phase_entry_required unless the matching entry was recorded in the latest literal prompt, or, for imm-planner, a run entry is live and a Managed claim is active; every other Skill and tool is left untouched. Seam: new tests/claude-phase-entry-skill-gate.test.ts on the hook output for Skill PreToolUse payloads, with allowed, denied and untouched controls.

Per Discovery evidence of docs/specs/explicit-phase-entry.spec.md (source: repository evidence scripts/build-claude-plugin.ts, hooks/hooks.json): hooks.json registers PreToolUse for the Skill tool and for the plugin enroll and start_unattended_batch tools, dist/claude/mcp-server.mjs is rebuilt from source, and the existing Claude tool-boundary tests pass with a recorded run entry and admission where they exercise enroll or start_unattended_batch.
